svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 997 x 497 mm with 40 mm flanges folded down on all four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges; the side flanges stop 25 mm short of each corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes, sideways from the centre line and back from the centre:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 110 mm fan holes at 350 each side, 173 back;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eight 11 mm post bolt holes at 460 each side, 165 and 235

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front and back of the centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one 25 mm gland hole for the panel cable at 200 left, 60 back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front and back flanges: two 9 mm cleat bolt holes at 410 and 430

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side, 18 mm up from the flange's lower edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: drops in from above inside the four walls; flanges riveted to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the walls, sealed with mastic; the plate's top is flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wall tops. The beams, fans and detector are fitted first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: drops in without forcing; all post holes over the beams.
